A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FCP research work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D are readable and support a reliable comparison, including material relocated between sections.

before.justification: v2 reports original coverage, prediction-set size, runtime, and ablation results on wind, traffic, and solar data in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains original benchmark and ablation results in Section 5 and Appendix D, including comparisons at 0.95 and 0.9 target coverage.

M1.justification: The Transformer context encoder, classifier-free guided flow, flow-matching training, Gaussian-ball prediction-set construction, and ODE procedures are retained. Revised explanations and Figure 1 annotations do not establish changed method inputs or steps.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same wind, traffic, and solar forecasting tasks, using outcome dimensions 2, 4, and 8 for wind/traffic and 2 and 4 for solar. No dataset or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same seven conformal comparators plus TFT and DeepAR. Both versions exclude TFT and DeepAR from the 0.9-coverage comparison and compare FCP, OT-CP, and MultiDimSPCI in the rolling-coverage figure.

E3.justification: The base predictors, data splits, training budgets, hyperparameter configurations, coverage targets, and ODE tolerances are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same volume-estimation sample counts of 4096, 8192, and 16384.

E4.justification: The encoder ablation, MLP-versus-iResNet ablation, and wind rolling-coverage analysis with window size 20 retain their evidence. Removing the short D.3 description does not remove the iResNet study: v2 Table 8 becomes v3 Table 7.

E5.justification: v3 Table 2 explicitly identifies the encoder-ablation uncertainty entries as standard deviations across five experiments on five constructed sequences; v2's caption did not specify this basis. This is a reporting clarification, with no documented increase in runs or new uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: v2 Table 6's eight FCP ODE evaluation-time entries are removed. Matched benchmark, training-time, and ablation results are retained; Table 1's numerical formatting changes are consistent with equivalent rounding or increased displayed precision.

T1.justification: v3 corrects v2 Theorem A.4 by separating continuous-image connectedness from closed-set preservation under a homeomorphism (A.4–A.5). It removes the optional compact-domain assumption and adjusts Eq. (96)'s coefficient to match the subsequent derivation. The i.i.d. and mixing assumptions now index scores through T rather than T+1, while the principal coverage-bound formulas remain unchanged.

C1.justification: Both versions claim flexible prediction sets for multidimensional time series, exact non-asymptotic marginal coverage, finite-sample conditional-coverage bounds, and smaller prediction sets while maintaining target coverage. The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain these contributions.

C2.justification: The conclusion changes the stated remaining research agenda: sharper coverage bounds are replaced by broader evaluations on diverse datasets with higher-dimensional outcomes, alongside optimal-transport coupling for efficiency. Interpretations of the existing benchmark and ablation findings remain essentially unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 removes the ODE evaluation-time information and clarifies that MultiDimSPCI's 15 trees belong to a quantile random forest. Hardware and hyperparameter disclosures remain, and the new reproducibility statement repeats the existing code access information.

R1.justification: v3 adds Rudin's Principles of Mathematical Analysis to support the connectedness theorem. Positioning relative to prior conformal, transport, and flow methods is retained; publication metadata updates do not introduce additional research works.

P1.justification: v3 edits wording throughout, moves supporting theory lemmas and stationarity/mixing definitions into Appendix A, adds a reproducibility statement, and removes redundant appendix text. The overall section sequence and research narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 revises the historical-context annotations and connections, and several captions and ablation labels are clarified. The evaluation-time table is removed, while the unchanged rolling-coverage figure and iResNet table are relocated together onto the final page.

improvement.justification: v3 repairs the overly general closed-set theorem and aligns Eq. (96)'s coefficient with its derivation, providing limited gains in mathematical precision. Clearer organization and uncertainty captions also help. Removing the sparsely documented evaluation-time table reduces computational transparency, but the main empirical evidence is preserved; the corrections and clarification provide a modest net improvement.
